- Tue 2026-05-11 10:00–10:45
- Wed 2026-05-12 09:00–09:45

1) quick intros and scope confirmation (5 min)
2) go through high-priority question IDs from your CSV (20 min)

- Which CAIQ version are you using (if applicable)?
- Do you expect log samples from production or a masked dev/test set?

Thanks for running this, Rafael — the call was helpful. Notes and quick clarifications below (forwarding to David Chen, our infra lead):

Meeting recap (from StrandView side):
- CAIQ version: CAIQv4 (we appended question IDs in CSV)
- We prefer production log samples but accept sanitized samples if production cannot be shared due to PII.
- NDA is in place with a limited redaction allowance; we will mark any items that cannot be shared.

Action items we captured:
1) Redwood to provide a single evidence bundle with readme and file manifest (who: Rafael) — due 2026-05-19
2) Redwood to confirm retention window docs and sample log export process (who: Aditya) — due 2026-05-14
3) StrandView to indicate any questions that require redaction or cannot be answered with artifacts (who: Angelina/David) — due 2026-05-13
4) Synchronous review after evidence handoff if StrandView requests (optional) — to be scheduled

Attachments sent after the call: StrandView flagged high-priority question IDs (we had the CSV), and David uploaded a short architecture diagram to the Drive link.

Regards,
Angelina Torres
Security Program Manager
StrandView Analytics
